app.name: WineTracker
lang.label: Language
auth.login.title: Sign in to your cellar
auth.register.title: Start your cellar
field.email.invalid: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
home.empty.title: Your cellar is empty
home.empty.body: Add the bottles you have at home. You can rate each one when you open it.
rating.title: How ratings work
rating.body: Rate from 0 to 10 glasses in half-glass steps. Each bottle you open gets its own rating, so you can compare it with your general opinion of the wine.
error.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match. Check both and try again.
error.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
error.unavailable: The service isn't reachable right now. Try again in a minute.
cellar.title: Cellar
cellar.filter.show_empty: Include wines with no bottles left
cellar.no_match.title: No wines match these filters
cellar.no_match.body: Try a different search, or clear the filters to see your whole cellar.
wine.new.title: Add a wine
wine.edit.title: Edit wine
wine.section.bottles.hint: Set quantity to 0 to save the wine without bottles, for example one you tasted elsewhere.
wine.nickname.hint: How you call it, e.g. "Crasto Superior".
wine.producer.hint: Pick one or type a new name.
wine.region.hint: Pick a country first. You can type a region that isn't listed.
wine.grapes.hint: One for a single variety, several for a blend. Press Enter after typing a new name.
wine.delete.confirm_body: This deletes "{name}" and its {count} bottles. It can't be undone.
wine.not_found: This wine doesn't exist or isn't yours.
bottles.add.title: Add bottles of {name}
bottles.table.caption: Bottles of {name}
bottle.edit.title: Edit bottle
bottle.delete.confirm_body: Use this for bottles added by mistake. For a bottle you gave away or lost, change its status instead so it stays in your history.
bottle.not_found: This bottle doesn't exist or isn't yours.
error.region_needs_country: Pick the country for this region.
error.pct_over: Percentages add up to more than 100%.
error.window_order: "Drink by" must be the same year as "Drink from" or later.
error.future_date: This date is in the future.
error.not_found: That item doesn't exist or isn't yours.
error.wine_has_history: This wine appears in your occasions, so it can't be deleted.
error.bottle_has_history: This bottle was opened at an occasion, so it can't be deleted.
error.bottle_consumed: Opened bottles can't be edited here.
occ.title: Occasions
occ.empty.title: No occasions yet
occ.empty.body: Record when you open a bottle: where you were, who was there, and how the wine was.
occ.new.title: Record an occasion
occ.edit.title: Edit occasion
occ.place_name.hint: e.g. the restaurant, or whose house
occ.people.hint: Type a name and press Enter. People you've been with before are suggested.
occ.delete.confirm_body: Bottles opened at this occasion go back to your cellar. This can't be undone.
occ.not_found: This occasion doesn't exist or isn't yours.
occ.wine.pick: Pick a wine from your list
occ.wine.missing: Not on your list? Add it first with quantity 0, then come back.
occ.rating.prefilled: Starts at your general rating for this wine. Move it if this bottle was different.
wine.tastings.none: You haven't recorded this wine at an occasion yet.
wine.tastings.average: Your bottles average {avg}, against a general rating of {general}.
error.bottle_not_available: That bottle isn't in your cellar any more. Pick another one.
error.bottle_wine_mismatch: That bottle belongs to a different wine.
